FREE SOURCE / RECORDED TOOL RUN

One brief. Four directions you can inspect.

First, an actual output from the free 0.18.0 generator. Then, a separately attributed selection from the creator’s wider gallery.

The input

Compare four visual directions for Clay House, a small pottery studio. Keep the class content and booking action identical. Use English throughout. Produce style cards and the bundled comparison page.

The decisions

Keep the two-hour class, $85 price, session choice and call to action fixed. Vary the design language: coastal glaze, porcelain gallery, evening kiln and studio journal.

Run evidence

Recorded with Codex and Chrome. The inputs, command output and generated files are retained. These screenshots show the produced artifact; they are not a simulated assistant conversation or a terminal mockup.

Recorded generator result: 4 cards
Artifacts: candidate HTML files + manifest.json + style-explorer.html
Boundary input: one card rejected with a non-zero exit code

EXISTING OIL UI PRO CONCEPT

Fieldwork Type

The task

Let designers try a typeface, adjust size, weight, and width, then choose the license they need.

What to look for

The type specimen is the main visual. The same editable text carries through the controls, so the product can explain itself.

EXISTING OIL UI PRO CONCEPT

Tide

The task

Design saved surf spots, a daily forecast, and a timeline that lets surfers inspect conditions at a chosen time.

What to look for

The wave, wind, tide, and time cursor share one moment. A light list and a dark forecast view give each task its own reading surface.

EXISTING OIL UI PRO CONCEPT

Nightwatch

The task

Design a service overview, an active incident, and a path from an error peak through logs and traces to a related release.

What to look for

The affected dependency chain leads the view. Timing connects the topology, metrics, and investigation evidence.
